CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2638 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 3f5400667c3a726b1d63c2f861f83488a80fadf4. Bus nonce: 508cecf4b349a024fb05e981235af1d5. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 3f5400667c3a726b1d63c2f861f83488a80fadf4`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 3f5400667c3a726b1d63c2f861f83488a80fadf4` or `Fix review: blocked 3f5400667c3a726b1d63c2f861f83488a80fadf4 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 508cecf4b349a024fb05e981235af1d5`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2638 3f5400667c3a726b1d63c2f861f83488a80fadf4") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2638-508cecf4`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, PR #2638 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer). This is the R10-CI-LAYOUT-P2 pre-PR and it is critical path: policy_lint treats a reusable-workflow caller of pr-contract as a caller, not as its definition. Head 3f5400667c3a726b1d63c2f861f83488a80fadf4. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. Re-read the head first; if it moved, the verdict is blocked.

Check:
1. tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs definesJob and contractWorkflowFiles. A job whose own body has a job-level uses: is a caller. The "exactly one file defines pr-contract" rule is unchanged.
2. The two new tests/entities.py checks fail against main's policy_lint and pass at the head. Run your own mutants, including these three:
   - drop the caller rule;
   - let a job body run into the next job;
   - treat a step-level uses: as a call.
   The nulls must hold:
   - the real job still counts when its steps use actions or when the next job is a caller;
   - two real definers still read as two;
   - the real tree has exactly one, pr-contract.yml.
3. On U0c's tree (git fetch origin handoff/r10-ci-layout-p2-u0c; head d22b5f303), main's lint returns rc 1 ("2 files define pr-contract") and the head's lint returns rc 0. On main, the head's lint returns rc 0.
4. This is a policy instrument. Say whether it is policy under CLAUDE.md, so the orchestrator can approve under the mandate at merge.
5. Read CI at the head from check-runs; policy-docs grades with main's lint. Check that the body's figures hold at this head (the opener merged main after the fixer measured).

ev/HEAD.txt must hold the full 40-hex head sha, or the relay refuses the verdict.
Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
